The Client  

Smart Energy Group is a full-service renewable solar energy company servicing Australia wide. They design and install bespoke solar solutions that reduce the energy costs of Australian households and businesses whilst improving Australia's green footprint. 

They seek an experienced Sales Recruitment Manager to join their team in Byron Bay, NSW.  

 

 

The Role 

The Sales Recruitment Manager is responsible for leading Smart Energy’s national Lead Generation recruitment function, ensuring every office has the talent required to achieve its growth and performance targets. Working closely with the National Recruitment Manager, this role oversees the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, including workforce planning, talent attraction, candidate management, onboarding, retention, and recruitment team performance. 

This is for a full-time role with an annual salary base set $80,000 plus superannuation. This role will be based in their Byron Bay office. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

Manage end-to-end recruitment for Lead Generation roles nationally. 

Execute hiring plans aligned with business growth targets. 

Manage candidate pipelines through Lever ATS and sourcing platforms. 

Conduct interviews, assessments, and candidate screening. 

Coordinate onboarding and candidate experience. 

Build and maintain future talent pipelines. 

Create engaging job advertisements across Seek, Indeed, Facebook, LinkedIn, and additional sourcing channels. 

Develop attraction strategies targeting school leavers, backpackers, hospitality professionals, retail talent, athletes, and sales professionals. 

Manage recruitment campaigns and analyse performance metrics. 

Support the growth of Smart Energy's employer brand nationally. 

Forecast hiring requirements alongside Sales Managers and Regional Leaders. 

Monitor Lead Generator-to-Specialist ratios nationally. 

Proactively identify recruitment risks and staffing gaps. 

Support office expansion and new office launches. 

Monitor retention trends and identify improvement opportunities. 

Conduct new starter surveys and feedback sessions. 

Partner with operational leaders to improve onboarding outcomes. 

Analyse attrition and recommend solutions. 

Lead, coach, and support the Lead Generation recruitment team. 

Assist with daily recruitment meetings and training sessions. 

Support implementation of recruitment KPIs and performance expectations. 

Deliver recruitment reporting and hiring insights. 

Foster a high-performance recruitment culture focused on quality, accountability, and speed. 

Track and report on Time to Hire, Cost per Hire, Source Effectiveness, Retention Rates, and Recruitment Funnel Conversion Ratios. 

Use recruitment data and insights to drive continuous improvement and informed decision-making. 

 

 

Requirements 

At least 4 years experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or workforce planning, ideally within a high-volume, target-driven environment. 

At least 4 years managing end-to-end recruitment processes, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding. 

At least 4 years leadership or team management experience, with the ability to coach, develop, and hold recruiters accountable to performance targets. 

At least 4 years stakeholder management experience, partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to forecast hiring needs and deliver recruitment outcomes. 

At least 4 years experience in building and maintaining talent pipelines for high-growth or rapidly scaling businesses. 

Demonstrated ability to work with recruitment metrics, reporting, and workforce planning data to drive hiring decisions. 

At least 4 years experience creating and managing recruitment advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, including Seek, LinkedIn, Indeed, and social media channels. 

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple vacancies, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously. 

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence candidates and internal stakeholders alike.
result.title: Sales Recruitment Manager

McDonald’s Ballina Shift Manager 

About the role

Join the dynamic team of our client, McDonald's Ballina, as a Shift Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and motivating a team to deliver exceptional customer service at our restaurant located in Ballina, NSW 2478. As a Shift Supervisor, you will play a key part in the smooth running of the restaurant and contribute to the overall success of the McDonald's brand.

McDonald’s Ballina Central and Ballina BP Travel Centre are owned and operated by a local Franchisee Business Dewbrook Pty Ltd. ABN: 88 217 299 573., with Licensee being Serrin Dewar. Serrin and her senior team are heavily involved int he day to day running of rate business and take a keen interest in the development of our management team. 

Perhaps you are already a Shift Manager or Department Manager with McDonald’s or other 'quick service' retailers, and you want to hone your skills further.. Or perhaps you are a senior Crew Trainer ready to take the next step into management?

What we offer

At McDonald's Ballina, we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. 

You'll enjoy competitive pay, opportunities for career advancement, and a range of benefits including employee discounts, training and development programs.

Our salaries are subject to the Fast Food Award, which has a base salary plus penalty rates depending on the roster. A typical roster equates to a salary range of approximately $75k-$80k base salary plus superannuation and benefits. 

We offer a flexible roster across 7 days of the week ( both of our stores are open 24 hrs) , however this role is strictly full time.

What you'll be doing
Overseeing the daily operations of the restaurant during your shift, including managing staff, handling cash and stock control
Candidates must be available to work rotating shifts including days, evenings and weekends as required
Ensuring excellent customer service by maintaining high standards of food quality, cleanliness and safety
Providing coaching and support to crew members to develop their skills and grow within the organisation
Analysing sales data and staffing requirements to drive operational efficiency
Acting as a brand ambassador and role model, embodying the McDonald's values and culture
Collaborating with the restaurant management team to implement strategic initiatives

What we're looking for
Previous experience in a management role, ideally within the hospitality industry. McDonald's qualifications a big advantage.
A minimum of 1-2 years of supervisory or management experience is preferred for this position.
Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire a team
Excellent customer service orientation and a passion for delivering high-quality experiences
Solid problem-solving and decision-making abilities to handle daily operational challenges
Numeracy skills and the ability to analyse data to drive process improvements
A flexible and adaptable approach to work, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Must be willing to relocate to or near Ballina.
Candidates must have Australian work rights and be legally eligible to work in Australia
Candidates must be 18 years of age or older to be considered for this role.

About us

McDonald's is a global leader in the fast-food industry, with a strong presence in Australia. Our Ballina restaurants are part of our ongoing commitment to providing high-quality food and exceptional customer service to the local community. Join our team and be a part of our success story.

Apply now to become the next Shift Manager at McDonald's Ballina.

NOTE: for candidates with the above skills and experience,  plus a min of a relevant Diploma qualification,  sponsorship may be an option under a labour agreement currently in application.

About us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the business
The business (ABN 24 638 483 600) is a locally owned real estate agency in Darwin, Northern Territory, servicing Darwin and Palmerston. They provide real estate sales, rental, property management and client-focused real estate services. They are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead agency growth, sales strategy, marketing campaigns and client acquisition.

About the Role
The Sales and Marketing Manager will plan, direct and coordinate the agency’s sales and marketing activities. The role will focus on growing property listings, improving brand visibility, developing client acquisition strategies and supporting the agency’s long-term business growth in the Darwin and Palmerston property markets.

Duties and Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
- Developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies for the agency.
- Leading campaigns to attract property sellers, buyers, landlords and tenants.
- Setting sales targets, marketing objectives and business development plans.
- Managing marketing budgets, campaign priorities and promotional activities.
- Reviewing market trends, local property data and competitor activity.
- Developing strategies to grow the agency’s property management portfolio and sales listings.
- Managing brand positioning, client engagement and digital marketing direction.
- Coordinating advertising campaigns for properties and agency services.
- Supporting and guiding staff involved in sales, marketing, leasing and client engagement.
- Building relationships with clients, referral partners, contractors and community networks.
- Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry conversion and business development outcomes.
- Preparing management reports and recommendations for business growth.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must have:
- A bachelor degree or higher qualification in business, marketing, management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- At least 3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development or management.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and implement sales and marketing strategies.
- Strong leadership, communication and negotiation skills.
- Experience managing campaigns, budgets, performance targets and client relationships.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation and customer engagement.
- Experience in real estate, property services or professional services will be highly regarded.
- Ability to analyse market trends and use data to support strategic decisions.
- Current driver licence is desirable.

How to Apply
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about real estate and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.
To apply, submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
- A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a dynamic real estate team and contributing to exceptional property and client experiences, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 20 August 2026

We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.
Responsibilities include:
•	Drive COPQ Reduction Across Sites: Lead initiatives to identify, address, and reduce COPQ at each manufacturing site, fast-tracking reduction actions.
•	Support Transformation Projects: Provide operational support for the successful execution of Transformation Projects, aiming to modernize manufacturing processes and systems.
•	Red List Site Support: Work directly with Red List sites to build operational foundations and enhance manufacturing readiness for growth, ensuring these sites meet operational standards.
•	Enhance Manufacturing Efficiency: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce downtime, improve throughput, and optimize resource utilization across sites.
•	Leadership Support: Assist site leaders in improving operational performance, driving COPQ reduction, and supporting data-driven decision-making to foster a culture of continuous improvement. 
•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across functions to drive transformation projects and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.

•	Adaptability: Ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

Working across Azure and AWS environments, you'll help strengthen infrastructure resilience, support security and compliance requirements, and participate in a 24/7 on-call roster.  As a DPA approved location with MM3 classification, this role is suitable for both VR GPs and non-VR GPs undertaking the PEP program. The practice is GP owned and non-corporate, offering private billing services and the flexibility to work part-time or full-time hours. With strong patient demand, the team of seven GPs is expanding into additional consulting rooms to meet growing community needs.
